title: Sopes
description: Sopes is a dish from Mexico prepared with masa harina, canned black beans, queso fresco, lettuce. This is a home-scale version with measured ingredients in the individual steps where they are used. Canned black beans mashed in a pan replace prepared refried beans.

steps.instruction: Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Shape, press or roll the prepared dough or mixture into portions appropriate to this dish.
Heat the pan over medium heat, shape or spoon out portions, and fry for about 15 minutes total until golden on both sides and fully cooked.
Warm and mash the drained canned black beans with a little oil to make a thick spread before topping the formed sopes.
Assemble the cooled components with the listed fillings or toppings. Refrigerate briefly if needed to set the layers.
